article_title: Harry Kane: Bayern Munich and England striker wins Ballon d'Or after record season

tasks.prompt: What central question does the article examine after Harry Kane's Ballon d'Or win?
options: Why Kane left Bayern Munich after one season
How Kane's extraordinary scoring outweighed the absence of a World Cup or Champions League title
Why English players are no longer eligible for the award
How Bayern failed to win any domestic trophies
tasks.correct_answer: How Kane's extraordinary scoring outweighed the absence of a World Cup or Champions League title
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה בוחנת כיצד תפוקת השערים החריגה של קיין הובילה לזכייה למרות שלא זכה במונדיאל או בליגת האלופות.

tasks.prompt: What distinction did Kane achieve for English football?
options: He became England's first Ballon d'Or winner.
He was the first English winner since Michael Owen in 2001.
He became the youngest winner in the award's history.
He was the first English player to finish in the top three.
tasks.correct_answer: He was the first English winner since Michael Owen in 2001.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: קיין היה האנגלי הראשון שזכה מאז מייקל אואן בשנת 2001, והחמישי מאנגליה בסך הכול.

tasks.prompt: Which statistic best captures Kane's record club season?
options: 36 goals in all competitions
73 goals in 51 Bayern matches
61 goals in 51 club matches, a Bayern season record
14 Bundesliga goals and 10 international goals
tasks.correct_answer: 61 goals in 51 club matches, a Bayern season record
tasks.explanation_hebrew: קיין כבש 61 שערים ב־51 משחקי מועדון — שיא עונתי לשחקן באיירן.

tasks.prompt: When Kane says he had to “bide my time”, what does he mean?
options: He had to change clubs every season.
He had to hide his ambitions from coaches.
He had to calculate how many minutes he played.
He had to wait patiently for opportunities while continuing to work.
tasks.correct_answer: He had to wait patiently for opportunities while continuing to work.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: bide my time פירושו להמתין בסבלנות להזדמנות המתאימה תוך המשך עבודה והתמדה.

tasks.prompt: How did Kane's 73 goals for club and country compare historically?
options: Only Lionel Messi's 82 in 2011–12 was higher among players from Europe's top leagues.
It equalled Lionel Messi's all-time total.
It was lower than every previous Ballon d'Or winner.
It was the first season in which any player passed 60 goals.
tasks.correct_answer: Only Lionel Messi's 82 in 2011–12 was higher among players from Europe's top leagues.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי הכתבה, רק 82 השערים של מסי ב־2011–12 עולים על 73 השערים של קיין במסגרת ההשוואה.

tasks.prompt: Why is Kane's victory described as unusual in the modern Ballon d'Or era?
options: He played fewer than half of Bayern's matches.
He had never represented England.
He won without taking the World Cup, Champions League or a major continental international title.
He received the award before the season ended.
tasks.correct_answer: He won without taking the World Cup, Champions League or a major continental international title.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ברוב השנים האחרונות הזוכים לקחו תואר מרכזי; קיין הוא רק המקרה החמישי בעשרים שנה ללא אחד מן התארים הגדולים המוזכרים.

tasks.prompt: Give three scoring achievements from Kane's 2025–26 season.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שלושה הישגי הבקעה מדויקים, עם מספרים או הקשר של מפעל.
expected_points: He scored 61 goals in all competitions for Bayern, a club season record.
He scored 36 Bundesliga goals, 17 more than anyone else.
He scored 10 German Cup goals, including a final hat-trick.
He scored 12 times for England, giving him 73 club-and-country goals.

tasks.prompt: Summarise why Kane won the award and why the victory was historically notable in 3–4 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לשלב את נתוני ההבקעה, היעדר התארים הגדולים והמשמעות ההיסטורית לאנגליה ולבאיירן.
expected_points: Kane produced an unmatched club season with 61 Bayern goals and 73 for club and country.
His output included a Bundesliga scoring title and records across competitions.
He won despite losing the World Cup and Champions League semi-finals.
He became the first English winner since 2001 and the first Bayern winner since 1981.

tasks.prompt: Evaluate the claim that individual performance mattered more than team trophies in Kane's win. Use at least three details.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג עמדה מנומקת ולהשתמש בלפחות שלוש ראיות, תוך התייחסות גם לתפוקה האישית וגם להישגים הקבוצתיים.
expected_points: Kane scored a Bayern-record 61 club goals and 73 for club and country.
He was 19 goals clear of every other player in Europe's top five leagues at club level.
Bayern won the German double, but Kane did not win the World Cup or Champions League.
Only four other winners in the past 20 years had won without one of the listed top international or European trophies.
His exceptional numbers therefore appear to have outweighed the usual emphasis on major trophies.

tasks.prompt: Write a short analytical paragraph on Kane's chances of retaining the Ballon d'Or next year.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לנסח ניתוח מאוזן הכולל גורם אחד לטובת קיין, תחרות מרכזית אחת ותנאי אפשרי לזכייה נוספת.
expected_points: Kane began the new season with 16 goals in 16 Bayern and England matches.
A Bayern Treble combined with continued scoring would strengthen his case.
Lamine Yamal has 10 goals and 10 assists and Barcelona are Champions League favourites.
Kylian Mbappe has also started strongly with 14 goals in 13 appearances.
Winning consecutive awards would be rare for anyone other than Messi or Ronaldo.
